---
title: "Cross-state comparison"
subtitle: "Compare any variable across selected jurisdictions"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
tar_source("R")

facts      <- tryCatch(tar_read(facts_latest),    error = function(e) tibble::tibble())
per_capita <- tryCatch(tar_read(facts_per_capita), error = function(e) tibble::tibble())
per_gsp    <- tryCatch(tar_read(facts_per_gsp),   error = function(e) tibble::tibble())
```

::: {.callout-note}
Pick a variable, the jurisdictions to compare, and the normalisation
view (absolute AUD millions, per-capita AUD, or share of GSP).
Selections are linked --- changing one widget updates every chart and
table on the page.
:::

```{r}
if (nrow(facts) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("No facts in the warehouse yet.")
} else {
  long <- facts |>
    transmute(jurisdiction, variable_id, canonical_label, category,
              fiscal_year, is_forward_estimate,
              value = value_aud_mil, view = "absolute_aud_mil") |>
    bind_rows(
      per_capita |> transmute(jurisdiction, variable_id, canonical_label,
                              category, fiscal_year, is_forward_estimate,
                              value = value_per_capita_aud,
                              view = "per_capita_aud")
    ) |>
    bind_rows(
      per_gsp |> transmute(jurisdiction, variable_id, canonical_label,
                           category, fiscal_year, is_forward_estimate,
                           value = value_share_gsp * 100,
                           view = "share_gsp_pct")
    )

  shared <- SharedData$new(long)

  bscols(
    widths = c(3, 9),
    list(
      filter_select("var",  "Variable",      shared, ~canonical_label),
      filter_select("view", "Normalisation", shared, ~view, multiple = FALSE),
      filter_checkbox("jur", "Jurisdictions", shared, ~jurisdiction,
                      inline = TRUE)
    ),
    plot_ly(shared,
            x = ~fiscal_year, y = ~value,
            color = ~jurisdiction,
            type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
            line = list(width = 2)) |>
      sbm_theme_fiscal(
        title       = "Selected variable",
        yaxis_title = "value"
      )
  )
}
```

## Underlying data

```{r}
if (nrow(facts) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("No facts to show.")
} else {
  facts |>
    select(jurisdiction, variable_id, canonical_label, fiscal_year,
           value_aud_mil, is_forward_estimate, estimate_type, document_id) |>
    arrange(variable_id, jurisdiction, fiscal_year) |>
    reactable(
      defaultPageSize = 15,
      searchable      = TRUE,
      filterable      = TRUE,
      striped         = TRUE
    )
}
```
